question.text: A member conducting proprietary and client trading without algo has BMC of Rs. 25 lakhs and now wants to add algo trading. What total BMC tier applies?

answer.text: Rs. 50 lakhs (all brokers with algo tier)

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook BMC table provides a single "all brokers with algo" tier at Rs. 50 lacs. Once a member adds algo trading, the applicable BMC tier becomes Rs. 50 lakhs, regardless of the number of algo strategies. Incremental BMC from the existing Rs. 25 lakhs prop-plus-client tier to the Rs. 50 lakhs with-algo tier is Rs. 25 lakhs. The Trap: Rs. 25 lakhs is the existing tier, not the new requirement; Rs. 75 lakhs assumes a per-algo add-on that the source table does not support. The member does need additional capital, so "no additional capital" is incorrect. Note: Source-backed to NISM-Series-IV workbook (Dec 2025), pages 289-290; per-algo add-on not found on the pages checked.
